description: GA single, wages + interest, flat 4.99% after $15,000 standard deduction
working: GA AGI = federal AGI = 65,000. 2026 standard deduction (HB 463) single 15,000 -> taxable 50,000. Tax 4.99% x 50,000 = 2,495.

description: GA head of household with one child: $5,000 dependent exemption; Georgia itemized deductions exceed the GA standard deduction but the federal return takes the standard deduction, so Georgia must too
working: GA AGI = 90,000. Georgia itemized would be 3,500 property (under $10,000 limit) + 12,000 mortgage = 15,500 > 15,000 GA standard, but federal Schedule A (6,993 SALT incl. GA tax + 12,000 = 18,993) is below the 24,150 federal HoH standard deduction, so the federal return does not itemize and IT-511 then requires the Georgia standard deduction: 15,000. Dependent exemption 1 x $5,000 = 5,000. Taxable 90,000 - 15,000 - 5,000 = 70,000. Tax 4.99% x 70,000 = 3,493.
